method: WITH paying AS (SELECT m.account_id, m.month_end, bool_or(m.status IN ('active', 'past_due')) AS is_paying FROM marts.fct_subscription_months m JOIN marts.dim_accounts a ON a.account_id = m.account_id WHERE NOT a.is_internal AND NOT a.is_deleted GROUP BY ALL), grid AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.date_day AS month_end FROM (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM paying) a CROSS JOIN marts.dim_date d WHERE d.is_month_end AND d.date_day BETWEEN DATE '2023-01-31' AND DATE '2025-06-30'), flags AS (SELECT g.account_id, g.month_end, coalesce(p.is_paying, false) AS is_paying FROM grid g LEFT JOIN paying p ON p.account_id = g.account_id AND p.month_end = g.month_end), cm AS (SELECT account_id, month_end, is_paying, coalesce(lag(is_paying) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month_end), false) AS was_paying_prior_month_end FROM flags) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN was_paying_prior_month_end AND NOT is_paying THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN was_paying_prior_month_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS logo_churn_rate FROM cm WHERE month_end = DATE '2025-04-30'
